data.name: Hawaii Foodie Budget Bike Tour
data.headline: Roll through paradise sampling Honolulu's exotic foods
data.description: This inclusive Bike Tour with four (4) foodie stops for food tasting is designed to acquaint travelers with local knowledge of Hawaii's Iconic eateries.
data.highlights: We will visit select Local Foodie stops outside of Waikiki with informative narration and complementary photos.
data.itinerary: We roll out of Waikiki, approximately 1-3 miles, to taste paradise.

meeting_point.address: Kuhio Beach Hula Mound  @ 2451 Kalakaua Ave, Honolulu, Hawaii 96815

data.what_is_included: We provide food tasting at four local locations in Honolulu. This tour includes cooked fish, shaved Ice, and a Malasada. We provide a 7-speed city bike with a protective helmet and cold water. We can adjust the menu for vegan or vegetarian.
data.what_to_bring: Wear covered shoes, We have a small bag on the bike for your phone/wallet.
data.cancellation_notes: Full refund if canceled within 24 hours of the scheduled tour.
data.booking_notes: NOTE: This bike tour visits multiple food trucks in the Honolulu province. Sunscreen and water are provided.
data.check_in_details: We don't have a retail location. We meet our guests at the Kuhio Beach Hula Mound.  AKA: Kuhio Beach Park. Address located at 2451 Kalakaua Ave, Honolulu, Hawaii 96815. There is a huge Banyan tree with a cutout for cars to pick up and drop off people.
data.health_and_safety_notes:
Tours are conducted on pedal bicycles equipped with safety lights. and reflective vests for visibility. Helmets and water are provided.  Bicycles are equipped with sanitation gel and wipes. 
The route is flat,  we traverse bike paths, sidewalks, and back streets. The lead guide is equipped with a first aid kit.
